Export a study as CSV files and a base-R manifest

Source: R/groundtruth.R
gt_export.Rd

Export a study as CSV files and a base-R manifest

Usage

gt_export(study, path)

Arguments

study

A gt_study returned by gt_runstudy() or gt_replay().

path

A destination path that must not already exist.

Value

The normalized destination path, invisibly.

Details

Writes data.csv, attempts.csv, targets.csv, summary.csv, seed-map.csv, scenarios.csv and manifest.R with versioned schemas, full RNG settings/map, character master seed, SHA256 file hashes, adapter metadata and provenance. Source identity is the SHA256 of the sole implementation file, R/groundtruth.R, recorded when the package is prepared. It identifies the study producer separately from the exporter. The CSV writer retains at least 17 significant digits; missing values are empty fields. Read according to manifest column types. dget() evaluates R expressions, so read only trusted manifests. Custom adapter code/state is not serialized. Any existing destination, including an empty directory, is refused. Export failure removes only the newly created destination.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
study <- gt_runstudy(gt_scenario("example"), reps = 2L)
gt_export(study, tempfile("groundtruth-"))
} # }
